title: Return types in tkinter.filedialog
author: Akuli
body_preview: If I cancel or close the dialog without selecting anything, I get:  ``` >>> import tkinter.filedialog >>> tkinter.filedialog.askdirectory() () >>>  ```  The stub says that the return type is `str`.
